title: app-shell(metadata-admin): the translation designer preview draws every spec-valid `globalActions` entry as `NAME[object Object]`, because it treats the category as flat strings
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, class (b), contract against renderer, with a reach measured on the real component. Reader: objectui triage first-touch (grade and route).
Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open + closed):
- "translation preview globalActions renders [object Object] flat category renderSampleValue": 0 hits;
- "TranslationPreview metadata admin translation designer preview object Object": 5 hits, all other designer-preview cards (for example objectui#10862 and objectui#3275), none about this category.

The second query is the positive control: it reaches the designer-preview card family.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat 3 (`session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`) from the objectui#11439 dev report (`6029864014`). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What happens

The translation designer's preview, `TranslationPreview` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/`), marks the `globalActions` category `flat: true` in its `CATEGORIES`, and its `renderSampleValue` draws a value with `String(v)`.

The spec declares `globalActions.NAME` as an action translation node (`actionTranslationSchema`), not a string. So every entry that `TranslationDataSchema.safeParse` accepts renders as text like `portfolio_snapshot[object Object]`.

Measured by the dev on the real component, objectui `c0862c1`, installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0. A bundle with `globalActions: { portfolio_snapshot: { label: … } }` gave `{ parsed: true, li: ['portfolio_snapshot[object Object]'] }`. The only sample that rendered cleanly was the preview's own `globalActions.close_order` flat string (`apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts`), which the spec refuses (`invalid_type`, expected object).

Seam: spec:TranslationDataSchema.globalActions → renderer:TranslationPreview (CategoryDef `flat`)

## Done when

- A spec-valid `globalActions` entry renders its translated fields (at least `label`) in the preview, as the object categories render theirs.
- Pin: a `TranslationDataSchema`-valid bundle with a `globalActions` node renders its label, and no `[object Object]` appears in the preview's text.

Note for the claimant: objectui#11439 (`pm:retriage`, this seat) moves the preview sample's `globalActions.close_order` to `objects.sales_order._actions.close_order`. After that move the preview sample carries no `globalActions` entry at all. So this card's pin needs its own spec-valid `globalActions` fixture.
